runtimeEnvironmentContract.cleanup: Retain named directories and failed files for caller inspection; no automatic deletion or stale-root reuse

monitorIOContract.activation: OwnerProcessMonitor(..., monitor_accounting=True, monitor_io_budget=v2Declaration); v1 and defaults unchanged
monitorIOContract.limitType: Nonnegative signed-64-bit integers; diagnostic caller declarations, not scientific admission limits
monitorIOContract.fileReadReservation: Known file length plus one EOF probe; failures and short reads stop without refunds or retries
monitorIOContract.writeReservation: Canonical UTF-8 receipt length before exclusive open; cumulative receipt limit excludes separately capped console
monitorIOContract.capture: Original three-file package unchanged. Separate terminalRoot/monitor-call.json preserves its earlier snapshot; terminal_publication_observation remains in memory after readback.
monitorIOContract.cleanup: Mandatory stream close and original-error preservation. Keep partial files; a poisoned shared budget cannot be reset to publish the terminal record.
monitorIOContract.terminalRoot: Canonical absolute caller path; fresh separate directory with existing parent; protected/runtime roots disjoint

jobLimitContract.units: Positive page-aligned committed virtual bytes within SIZE_T and signed-64-bit range; positive DWORD simultaneous active-process count
jobLimitContract.setup: Set KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE, JOB_MEMORY and ACTIVE_PROCESS; query exact flags/count/commit before process creation; no fallback on setup/readback failure
jobLimitContract.failureSemantics: Commit requests exceeding the job ceiling fail; process association exceeding concurrent count fails. A child may handle refusal; exit code is not a violation count.
jobLimitContract.scope: Assigned job plus descendant/nested-job members; calling monitor is outside this job
jobLimitContract.capture: Copied plan in owner-process.json and terminal source binding; applied/verified configuration record in process observation; common ledger validates optional block

processCleanupContract.activation: All new helper observations; prior observations without this additive block remain readable
processCleanupContract.waitPolicy: One monotonic cleanup deadline for termination, job drain and root wait; floor remaining milliseconds; zero-time poll after exhaustion; no repeated termination after a failed attempt
processCleanupContract.errorPolicy: Original body exception remains primary; otherwise first cleanup failure is raised. Later failures are notes and pre-callback cleanup errors. Observer failure propagates only when no earlier error exists.
processCleanupContract.capture: After all acquired handle-close attempts, before observer callback. includesHandleCleanup denotes inclusion of attempts, not proof all closes succeeded.

monitorSerializationContract.activation: Existing monitor I/O v1/v2 publication API; default monitor without I/O budget is unchanged
monitorSerializationContract.acceptedTypes: Exact built-in dict/list/tuple/str/int/finite-float/bool/None; dictionary keys must be exact strings
monitorSerializationContract.canonicalEncoding: Sorted string keys, compact separators, standard-library string escaping, UTF-8 with ensure_ascii false and finite numbers
monitorSerializationContract.prechecks: String code-point lengths; container minimum output size; cumulative key lengths before sorting; hexadecimal digit lower bound before decimal integer conversion
monitorSerializationContract.payloadBudget: Minimum of per-publication ceiling and remaining total write budget; output checked before extending the buffer
monitorSerializationContract.temporaryMemory: Bounded in terms of the caller byte allowance, fixed chunk size and fixed depth, not a numeric Python allocator/RSS ceiling. Output bytearray and final bytes copy coexist.
monitorSerializationContract.failure: No publication open or write reservation on encoding failure; monitor I/O scope is poisoned. A caller-handled exception cannot suppress a new hash-close failure.

handleInheritanceContract.activation: All new calls through bounded_windows_process.run, including default log mode; no new option or receipt schema.
handleInheritanceContract.creation: STARTUPINFOEXW with EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT, CREATE_SUSPENDED and CREATE_NO_WINDOW; preserve Unicode environment flag when present.
handleInheritanceContract.initialization: Expected sizing error, bounded allocation, initialize two attributes, set only two standard handles inheritable, install handle list and one-job list; failure prevents creation without fallback.
handleInheritanceContract.cleanup: Restore prior standard-handle flags independently and delete initialized list once; preserve body or first cleanup error. A verified assigned child is terminated/drained on startup-cleanup failure; failed membership verification uses direct root termination and unknown coverage.
handleInheritanceContract.boundary: Direct child creation by this helper; standard handles can propagate to descendants.

atomicJobCreationContract.activation: All new bounded_windows_process.run launches; no option or receipt schema change.
atomicJobCreationContract.setup: Configure kill-on-close and optional limits before creation. Supply one job in STARTUPINFOEX. Create suspended, verify membership, finish startup cleanup, then resume.
atomicJobCreationContract.failure: Setup or unsupported attribute stops without fallback; false/failed membership never resumes and retains unknown coverage. Job-handle close covers an owner exit immediately after creation.
atomicJobCreationContract.receiptCompatibility: suspended-owned-job-v1 still denotes suspended owned execution; pinned helper hash distinguishes atomic creation from historical separate assignment.

failureDiagnosticsContract.activation: All new shared-helper error observations and secondary notes; existing receipt schemas unchanged.
failureDiagnosticsContract.notePolicy: Append only to exact built-in lists below the ceiling. Preserve caller-owned full or unsupported note objects unchanged; do not inspect their elements.
failureDiagnosticsContract.formatting: Native BaseException args/dict descriptors; exact strings/scalars only. Unsupported objects and oversized integers use literal markers. Custom metaclasses use a fixed class label.
failureDiagnosticsContract.failure: Literal fallback if formatting itself raises. Annotation is best effort and cannot replace the original exception or skip subsequent cleanup.
failureDiagnosticsContract.compatibility: Single-string text remains unchanged below its cap; other representations normalize to class/selected args and may omit special fields such as OSError filename. Original exception and traceback remain intact.

monitorFailureContract.activation: Outer Windows monitor with or without optional accounting; no new option or receipt schema.

monitorIOFinalizerContract.activation: Existing monitor I/O v1/v2 hash and inventory operations; no option, limit or receipt schema changes.
monitorIOFinalizerContract.secondaryErrorDetails: Omitted; notes identify only the failed hash or inventory close.

runtimeFailureContract.activation: Existing runtime environment v1 with optional outer monitor accounting; no new option or receipt schema.
runtimeFailureContract.exceptionDetails: Omitted from runtime error field; original exception object propagates to the caller.

jsonFailureContract.activation: Existing Counters.write_json_output and OwnerFileCounters.write_json; no new option or receipt schema.
jsonFailureContract.failedCounterReceipts: Failed outcome even when caller requests success; numeric counters remain best-effort diagnostics.

ownerFinalizerContract.activation: Existing OwnerFileCounters.operation, copyfile and child_log; no option or receipt schema change.
ownerFinalizerContract.suppressedMetadataErrors: Unknown samples retain previous semantics; they alone do not fail the wrapper.
ownerFinalizerContract.returnedResults: False/None and process timeout/nonzero results remain completed API scopes, not child-success claims.

readFinalizerContract.activation: Existing counted raw/hash/parser/decoder/text reads and worker receipt completion; no new option or receipt schema.
readFinalizerContract.failedReadProgress: Unknown; bytes hidden by a thrown read are not invented.

publicationFinalizerContract.activation: Existing Python v1-v4 worker publication paths and cooperative sidecars; no new options or receipt schemas.
publicationFinalizerContract.errorMessage: Publication operation failed; exception details omitted.
